what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no budget votes; its only vote was a unanimous voice vote to adjourn.
The school superintendent presented her recommended FY15 budget, covering enrollment, school choice, staffing history and the main cost drivers.
She said the gap between her recommended budget and the town manager's budget has grown.
Out-of-district tuition rises, and circuit breaker reimbursement from the state arrives a year behind the cost.
Monty Tech's business manager showed how Lunenburg's assessment is built from the state's required minimum, transportation and bonds.

why_it_matters: The school budget and the Monty Tech assessment are both paid mostly from taxes, and the gap between the school and town manager budgets is what the committee must settle before Town Meeting.
Out-of-district tuition and a reimbursement that lags a year can push school costs up faster than the budget in hand.
